details.description: Flash Acrylic Colour 200ml artist-grade acrylic paint for art, craft and paint work on paper, canvas, wood, fabric, glass and ceramics.
details.usageInstructions: Stir well. Apply with a brush. Add a little water to thin. Close the lid tightly after use. Wash brushes with water immediately.
details.dangerWarnings: Non-toxic but not for eating. Keep away from small children. Avoid contact with eyes.
